test_title: PYST 33: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 14 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

Syam does not __intervene__ in others’ affairs.
solution:
The correct answer is **Meddle**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Intervene **means to involve oneself in a situation where one is not wanted or invited. (अपने आप को ऐसी स्थिति में शामिल करना जहां कोई वांछित या आमंत्रित नहीं है)

 
 
• **Example**:* The teacher had to intervene to stop the argument between the students.*
 
 
 
• Marked option **Meddle **means to interfere in someone else's business or affairs without being asked or invited. (बिना पूछे या आमंत्रित किए किसी दूसरे के व्यवसाय या मामलों में हस्तक्षेप करना)
 
 
• **Example**: *It's best not to meddle in other people's personal affairs without their consent.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'meddle' is the most appropriate synonym for 'intervene' in this sentence.

Thus, **option 1** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Speak **means to say something or express one's thoughts or opinions. (कुछ कहना या अपने विचार या राय व्यक्त करना)
 
• **Trouble **means to cause problems or difficulties for someone. (किसी के लिए समस्याएँ या कठिनाइयाँ पैदा करना)
 
• **Help **means to assist or support someone in need. (किसी जरूरतमंद की सहायता या समर्थन करना)
